name: Chrysoberyl
source:
"Kyahahaha! Okay, just open the book."

Mysterious girl appearing in front of the protagonist group

She looks like Yoruko but has an entirely different personality. The elusive girl always emerges from the dark with a "magic book" open on one hand.

[Translated from [url=http://kagura.rdy.jp/kamimaho/character_chrysoberyl.html]official website[/url]]
